props.gloss_en: one may annul vows on Shabbat
and one may ask [a sage for release] from vows that are for the needs of Shabbat
and one may seal the light-opening
and one may measure a rag
and one may measure a mikveh

an incident in the days of R' Tzadok's father and of Abba Shaul ben Botnit: they sealed the light-opening with a jug, and tied a shard with reed-grass, to know whether the roofing had an opening of a handbreadth or not
and from their words we learned that one may measure on Shabbat
and from their words we learned that one may tie on Shabbat
